title: Reverse and rescale
hints: Compare the coefficient of nitrogen dioxide.
Compare the result with each choice and check its sign, units, or underlying rule.
solution: Reverse for $+114$ kJ, then halve the equation for $+57$ kJ.
statement:
$\ce{2NO(g) + O2(g) -> 2NO2(g)}$ has $\Delta H=-114$ kJ as written. What is $\Delta H$ for $\ce{NO2(g) -> NO(g) + 1/2 O2(g)}$?

[_]{a}

explanations: The amount was halved without reversing the sign.
The equation was reversed without halving.
Both sign and factor are incorrect.
